mapper.select: SELECT r.gift_id, r.reminder_type, r.read_at FROM reminder r JOIN gift g ON g.gift_id = r.gift_id JOIN family f ON f.family_id = g.family_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND r.read_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT g.gift_id, g.family_id, s.investment_end_date AS maturity_date, pv.product_name, p.product_type FROM gift g JOIN family f ON f.family_id = g.family_id JOIN simulation_result sr ON sr.simul_result_id = g.simul_result_id JOIN simulation s ON s.simul_id = sr.simul_id
JOIN simulation_portfolio sp ON sp.simul_portfolio_id = s.selected_portfolio_id AND sp.simul_result_id = sr.simul_result_id JOIN simulation_product spr ON spr.simul_portfolio_id = sp.simul_portfolio_id AND spr.is_selected = 1 JOIN kb_product_version pv ON pv.kb_product_version_id = spr.kb_product_version_id JOIN kb_product p ON p.product_id = pv.product_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND g.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND p.product_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS')
AND g.sequence_no = ( SELECT MIN(e.sequence_no) FROM gift e WHERE e.simul_result_id = g.simul_result_id AND e.status <> 'CANCELLED' )
AND g.gift_id = #{giftId}
ORDER BY s.investment_end_date, g.gift_id, FIELD(p.product_type, 'DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS'), pv.product_name
